source_brief.scene: An original giant cyan/coral manta-ray contour light sculpture above a dark supported walkway. Body and multiple finite wing-tip and helix-tail pose frames are separately layered, one clean coherent pose bright in hero. Four bottom storyboard cells show body lifted with low wing tips; wing tips lifting while tail remains curved; body lowering with wings high; tail following the body down. Discrete snapshots and clear delayed appendage positions, no fake continuous motion blur.
